comment: The three actuator-specific executor names the runtime registers, each mapped to exactly one protected-circuit outcome, with the contexts that may command it. release_relay restores the load and is never a profile outcome: it is what local arm and local reset do.

cases.note: Isolates the load. A profile trip commands it through the zone's mapping; a Tier C approved action may also reach it.
Isolates the supply. Registered today as the same executor as trip_relay; the word close describes the valve, not the outcome.
Restores the load. Never a profile outcome, never remote: only local arm and local reset perform it, under the trip-state rules.
